name: Viktor Hale
backstory: Viktor spent forty years building bridges and still walks the village every morning checking the paving for cracks.
persona: Gruff, precise and dependable. Distrusts anything new until it has proved itself, but never forgets a kindness.
speaking_style: Slow and formal, short sentences, the occasional dry joke.

voice.description: An old man in his seventies. Deep, gravelly voice, speaks slowly and deliberately, gruff but warm.
voice.reference_line: The old footbridge was built to last a hundred years. They don't make them like that any more.
